ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity ratio with a dominant high-reflectance white central field comprising approximately 75% of the visible surface area, bounded by a low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white field (high intensity) across the central right lobe; wide continuous black band (low intensity) along the trailing edge; yellowish-tan irregular blotch centered in the lower-mid quadrant of the right lobe; multiple discrete dark circular pixel clusters distributed throughout the white field; distinct glyph-like dark marking resembling an inverted 'A' near the right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression at the center-line; approximately 45-degree angle of convergence at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the right lobe trailing edge; peaks are irregularly spaced with larger jagged projections toward the distal tip; left lobe edge partially obscured by water spray, preventing continuous mapping.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curve originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips; trailing edge exhibits a non-linear, scalloped progression.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular dark-on-light pixel groups visible across the right lobe surface; high density of small circular marks near the trailing edge border; distinct white-on-black raised bumps (potential barnacle colonization) localized on the outer right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, thin, low-intensity linear streaks visible on the right lobe, primarily oriented vertically relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable dark pigment marking near the upper-right trailing edge; visible yellowish surface staining across the center of the right lobe fluke surface; jagged, uneven erosion along the right distal tip boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark pixel configuration near the right distal tip resembling a stylized alphanumeric character; substantial water spray occlusion on the left fluke lobe limiting lateral symmetry analysis.
